title: Необходимое условие и гарантия результата
description: Необходимое условие и гарантия результата: применяем правило в новых ситуациях, разбираем словарь, диалог и авторский текст без аудирования.
objectives: Не превращать допуск к рассмотрению в обещание отбора
notes: Необходимое условие должно выполняться для результата; достаточное условие обеспечивает результат в заданной системе правил.
“A score of eighty is necessary” не означает “eighty guarantees selection”: могут действовать другие требования и ограничения.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: “The certificate is necessary but not sufficient for admission” means ___.

options.label: It is required, but other conditions still matter.

exercises.editorial_answer: It is required, but other conditions still matter.
exercises.explanation: Фраза утверждает обязательность сертификата без самостоятельной гарантии поступления.

exercises.prompt: Вставь слово из пары: guarantee / guarantees.

public_payload.sentence: Meeting one condition does not necessarily ___ the outcome.

exercises.editorial_answer: Meeting one condition does not necessarily guarantee the outcome.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Соответствие условиям допуска необходимо, но само по себе недостаточно для отбора.»
exercises.editorial_answer: Eligibility is necessary but not sufficient for selection.
exercises.explanation: Допуск и положительный итоговый выбор — разные этапы.

public_payload.passage: The fellowship rules required applicants to score at least eighty in an initial assessment before their proposals could be considered. Places were limited, and the final panel also evaluated the proposals against published criteria. One applicant scored eighty-two and announced that selection was therefore guaranteed. The administrator explained that the threshold established eligibility for the next stage, not a sufficient condition for receiving a place. An applicant below the threshold would not pass that stage under the stated rules, but exceeding it did not remove competition or the proposal review. A precise summary had to preserve both directions: the threshold mattered, and the threshold alone did not settle the outcome. Neither “irrelevant” nor “automatic acceptance” represented the rule accurately.

options.label: Automatic selection regardless of the proposal.
Eligibility for the next stage, not a guaranteed place.

exercises.editorial_answer: Eligibility for the next stage, not a guaranteed place.
exercises.explanation: Порог был условием допуска к рассмотрению.

exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: necessary — необходимый; sufficient — достаточный; eligibility — соответствие условиям допуска; selection — отбор.

lines.text: How can a condition be necessary without being sufficient?

options.label: It need not be met and always guarantees the result.
It has no possible relation to the result.
It must be met, but further conditions may also be required.
